source_name: Hipotekarna banka AD Podgorica – Izvještaji (financial, audit, annual, public disclosure, sustainability)
why_relevant: Deep, well-structured self-published archive: quarterly balance sheet/income statements (2007-2026), independent auditor reports (2007-2025), annual reports (2009-2025), 'javno objavljivanje' prudential disclosures (2011-2026) and sustainability/impact reports (2023-2024). One of the most complete single-bank time series in Montenegro.

source_name: Hipotekarna banka – Obavještenja (shareholder assembly / skupština akcionara notices)
why_relevant: Corporate-action and general-assembly notices (e.g. 'XIX redovna sjednica Skupštine akcionara') carry agendas, capital increases, dividend and board decisions that never appear in the financial statements themselves.

source_name: Erste Bank AD Podgorica – Godišnji izvještaj banke
why_relevant: Single page consolidating 2009-2026 annual financial statements with independent auditor opinions plus quarterly and half-yearly 'javno objavljivanje podataka' (Pillar 3-equivalent) PDFs for the Montenegrin Erste subsidiary.

source_name: Erste Group CDN document store for Erste Bank Montenegro
why_relevant: Actual file host behind erstebank.me report links; stable DAM paths make long-horizon archival and change-detection easier than scraping the rendered page.

source_name: NLB Banka AD Podgorica – Finansijski izvještaji
why_relevant: NLB's Montenegrin subsidiary publishes annual, semi-annual and quarterly reports plus 'Izvještaj o javnom objavljivanju' disclosure documents; page has an EN/ME toggle, which is unusual for the market and eases parsing.

source_name: Addiko Bank AD Podgorica – Finansijski izvještaji (mediji i publikacije)
why_relevant: Annual financial reports plus quarterly/semi-annual 'javno objavljivanje podataka' from 2011 to 2026, explicitly framed under Article 237 of the Zakon o kreditnim institucijama — i.e. the Montenegrin Pillar 3 equivalent.

source_name: Prva banka Crne Gore AD Podgorica – Finansijski izvještaj
why_relevant: Domestically owned systemically visible bank; publishes audited statements (Deloitte, BDO) and 'Izvještaj o javnom objelodanjivanju podataka' PDFs under a flat /uploads/ path. Legacy PHP site, so file naming is inconsistent and needs link-following rather than pattern guessing.

source_name: Lovćen banka AD Podgorica – Izvještaji o poslovanju
why_relevant: Annual business reports, audited financial statements with notes, and auditor reports back to at least 2017; documents served from a separate media API host, which is a stable harvesting target.

source_name: Adriatic Bank AD Podgorica – Reports / Izvještaji
why_relevant: Fast-growing mid-size bank (~EUR 374m assets, ~4.7% share per third-party ranking) publishing audited financial statements, management reports and periodic 'public disclosure of data'. Reports appear in English as well as local language — rare in this market.

source_name: Universal Capital Bank AD Podgorica – Annual and Financial Reports
why_relevant: UCB splits disclosure into three clean, separately crawlable sections — annual/financial reports, independent external auditor reports, and data disclosure — which maps directly onto the annual-report / audit / Pillar-3 taxonomy.

source_name: Universal Capital Bank – News & Announcements
why_relevant: Bank-issued press releases including payments-relevant operational news (e.g. clearing of international payments with Serbia and BiH) — a direct signal channel for payments-infrastructure moves not present in financial statements.

source_name: Ziraat Bank Montenegro AD Podgorica – Godišnji izvještaji
why_relevant: Turkish-owned bank's dedicated annual-report page carrying auditor reports and 'javno objelodanjivanje podataka' from 2015 onward, including quarterly/semi-annual disclosures. Not linked from the obvious homepage navigation, so it is easy to miss.

source_name: Zapad banka AD Podgorica – Uslovi poslovanja i finansijski izvještaji
why_relevant: Publishes quarterly and annual financial reports and public disclosures; also bundles general business terms and tariffs on the same page, which doubles as a pricing/fee-change signal for payments work.

source_name: Montenegro Stock Exchange (Montenegroberza) issuer pages for listed banks
why_relevant: Montenegrin banks are joint-stock companies (AD); the market-participant/issuer registry links per-bank issuer records and the disclosure filings that accompany shareholder assemblies, capital changes and ownership shifts — a route to bank disclosures that do not sit on the bank's own site.

source_name: CBCG Godišnji izvještaj o radu (regulator annual report, sector aggregate context)
why_relevant: Sector-level annual report giving the denominator (system assets, profitability, capital adequacy) against which an individual bank's self-published earnings can be benchmarked; also names supervisory actions affecting specific banks.

source_name: thebanks.eu – Montenegro bank profiles (asset rankings and market share)
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator giving comparable total-assets and market-share rankings per Montenegrin bank in English; useful for prioritising which bank IR sites to poll most often and for cross-checking self-reported figures. Secondary source — never a substitute for the bank's own PDF.

source_name: CRPS — Centralni registar privrednih subjekata (public entity search)
why_relevant: Statutory company register of Montenegro; single authoritative record of legal form, status (aktivan / u stečaju / u likvidaciji / brisan), founding date, registered seat and legal representatives for every bank, payment institution, fintech and vendor subsidiary operating in ME. Baseline entity spine for the whole A1 workstream.

source_name: CRPS institutional portal (crps.me) — procedures, forms, regulations, notices
why_relevant: Explains what must be filed, by whom, on which forms, and under which law; publishes registry notices (e.g. establishment of the beneficial-owner register on 1 Aug 2021). Best pointer for understanding coverage and completeness of ME statutory filings.

source_name: eFirma — CRPS electronic company portal
why_relevant: The transactional front end of the register (e-registration, e-extracts, beneficial owners). Indicates digitisation level of ME registry and is the channel through which official extracts (izvod) can be ordered for named financial-sector entities.

source_name: Registar stvarnih vlasnika (Register of Beneficial Owners), CRPS
why_relevant: UBO data for all ME legal entities, established 1 Aug 2021 under the AML/CFT law. The only structured way to see who really controls unlisted payment firms, exchange offices, agent networks and vendor subsidiaries.

source_name: Uprava prihoda i carina (Revenue and Customs Administration) — eProijava/TaxisPortal financial-statement filing system
why_relevant: Statutory receiving body for annual financial statements (finansijski iskazi) and audit reports of all ME legal entities; hosts the filing software and the 'Podnošenje / Pregled finansijskih iskaza' functions. This is where unlisted banks', PSPs' and vendors' accounts physically land.

source_name: gov.me — Uprava prihoda i carina news & document library (financial reporting notices)
why_relevant: Central government CMS publishing tax-administration announcements, filing-software releases, and the Pravilnik defining financial-statement forms. Reliable early signal for changes to filing formats/deadlines that affect any scraping pipeline.

source_name: Pravilnik o sadržini i formi obrazaca finansijskih iskaza (Sl. list CG 011/20)
why_relevant: Defines the exact schema (bilans stanja / bilans uspjeha / iskaz o novčanim tokovima) of every filed ME annual account. Essential to build a stable parser and to map ME line items to comparable metrics.

source_name: Zakon o računovodstvu Crne Gore (Sl. list CG 84/2025) — legal basis for filing & publication
why_relevant: Sets who must file, deadlines (statements to the tax authority by 31 March), audit thresholds and applicable standards. New law published 31 Jul 2025, in force 8 Aug 2025 — a live change that may alter filing scope/format for 2025 accounts.

source_name: Zakon o reviziji + registar ovlašćenih revizora i revizorskih društava
why_relevant: Defines the statutory audit register and which entities must file audited accounts. The auditor register is itself an actor map (Big-4 vs local firms auditing ME banks and PSPs) and a snowball source for audited-entity lists.

source_name: MONSTAT — Uprava za statistiku Crne Gore (Statistical Office)
why_relevant: Official producer of ME statistics, including the statistical business register and structural business statistics covering NACE K (financial and insurance activities). Provides the sector-aggregate denominator against which individual bank/PSP filings are benchmarked.

source_name: MONSTAT Statistički biznis registar (SBR) — methodology and outputs
why_relevant: Documents how MONSTAT builds its business register from administrative sources (CRPS, tax administration), including stratification by activity and size. Tells you exactly which administrative datasets exist behind the scenes and how complete/current they are — a key pointer for feasibility of entity-level coverage.

source_name: MONSTAT Statistical Yearbook / Statistički godišnjak
why_relevant: Annual consolidated volume including finance chapters and data sourced from other official producers (CBCG, ministries). Convenient stable-URL time series for sector aggregates and enterprise counts by activity.
